summary: Busy-ish kerb where cars park, with homes 13 m away behind the kerb.

best_section.where: West kerb of Fairley Street, midway along, opposite the Taringa soccer fields

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 13 m (at 33 m) and 14 m (apartments at 55 m) on the same side; park and trees opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parking lane, cars parked along it; no drive-in needed.
drivers.traffic: Collector road past a park and school; steady traffic likely.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both sides, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on same side
sun_shade: Mixed: street trees shade the kerb, mostly from the east and afternoon.
